stem: If the sum of the coefficients in the expansion of \((\alpha x^{2} - 2x + 1)^{35}\) is equal to the sum of the coefficients in the expansion of \((x - \alpha y)^{35}\), then \(\alpha =\)
solution: Put \(x = 1\) in \((\alpha x^{2} - 2x + 1)^{35}\). Sum of coefficients in the expansion of \((\alpha x^{2} - 2x + 1)^{35} = (\alpha - 1)^{35}\). Now, similarly, sum of coefficients of \((x - \alpha y)^{35}\) is \((1 - \alpha)^{35}\). According to the question, \((\alpha - 1)^{35} = (1 - \alpha)^{35}\), hence \(\alpha = 1\).

stem: The number of 5 digit numbers that contain 7 exactly once is
solution: When 7 is at the 10000th place, there are 9 choices for each of the remaining places, so the total possible ways is \(9^{4}\). Hence the total number of ways is \(9^{4} + \left(4 \times 8 \times 9^{3}\right) = 41 \times 9^{3}\).

\(\Rightarrow \sin \theta(1 + \sin^{2} \theta) = 1 - \sin^{2} \theta\)

\(\Rightarrow 8\cos^{2} \theta + \cos^{6} \theta - 4\cos^{4} \theta = 4\)

solution:
